svg.text: API decisions: GPU type, profiles and responses
POST /api/v1/inference/right-sizing/recommendation | Implemented request and response branches
Start with an authorized, valid request
Required: clusterId, image and exact tag. Optional: gpuType. Inventory is read completely before profile selection.
Invalid input -> 400. Missing credentials / denied permission -> 401 / 403 at the access boundary.
Evaluate every distinct reported GPU type/capacity pair.
There is no single global winner across GPU types.
Evaluate only the exact inventory GPU type, at each reported capacity.
Use the exact image and tag.
Continue with an empty profile set.
Missing or nonpositive capacity -> no_recommendation for this entry.
Resolve the exact PCI identity. Unknown or ambiguous inventory names can still use GPU-agnostic profiles.
An eligible baseline has a profile ID, explicit TP=1 and PP=1, and a positive, finite published minimum.
First matching rule wins; evaluate all candidates
Empty / missing tested list is OK
only a GPU name is supplied.
Select a profile and return this entry
Keep fitting profiles first; if none fit, retain a baseline for an explicitly estimated GPU count.
Prefer direct > tested > GPU-agnostic. Within the tier: lowest minimum, then profile ID.
profileId, precision, inferenceBackend and published minimum
recommendation: allocation + warning; estimated count if oversized
Missing capacity, no eligible minimum or no matching profile.
Return a clear reason; no recommendation object.
A nonempty tested list is evidence, not an exclusive allowlist. Untargeted profiles may still be GPU-agnostic.
HTTP 200 can contain both recommended and no_recommendation entries. Empty inventory returns results: [] without an NGC lookup.
